slides.title: Keeping clinics running as fighting returns
slides.body: An ICRC update from northern Ethiopia

slides.title: health facilities supported in Tigray
slides.body: Plus 32 in Amhara, according to the International Committee of the Red Cross (ICRC).

slides.title: Medicines reached Tigray hospitals
slides.body: Equipment and medicines were delivered Oct 13-16, including to Suhul-Shire, Ayder Referral, Alamata and Mehoni.

slides.title: people moved from Mekelle to Semera
slides.body: On Sept 28, with the ICRC acting as a neutral intermediary.

slides.title: household kits pre-positioned in Tigray
slides.body: Plus 2,000 in Amhara and 2,400 for recently displaced civilians in Afar.

slides.title: Water restored in Lalibela
slides.body: Emergency repairs to the town's water supply system brought back access to water, the ICRC says.

slides.title: Respect the laws of war. Protect health care.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.
